title: Infinite Go: unbounded sparse board Go variant
description: Go on a sparse unbounded board. No dimensions, no edges. Demonstrates sparse grid with the most demanding adjacency/liberty/capture mechanics. Rules: standard Go except no fixed board size. Scoring: Chinese area counting (stones + surrounded territory) with agreed bounding box at game end, or capture-only (Atari Go) variant. Superko rule ensures termination. Requires: sparse grid (baize-ew83).
close_reason: Game definition created. Sparse unbounded board, orthogonal_4 adjacency, superko rule, capture-only scoring. Parses and round-trips in both engines.
